label: D1 reward after reaching S2 (strongest after rare a1->S2 reward; weak late-episode S2 reward)
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1 (never at GO/D2, never when unrewarded). Almost all activation is when the previous trial reached S2 and was rewarded. The main, high-magnitude component is a rare-rewarded trial, a1 -> S2 rewarded (D1 & in_rew==1 & prev_common==0 & prev_action==1: precision 0.45, about 71% of activation mass, covering 79% of the top quartile). Rare a2 -> S1 rewarded never fires, so this unit is a1/S2-specific, not a general rare-reward unit. A second, weak component fires on ordinary rewarded S2 visits (often common a2 -> S2 streaks) late in the episode (ep_trial >= 90). Magnitude grows with episode time: nothing fires before trial ~30, and the rate climbs steeply over trials 40-99. It is also higher when the model value is low (value < 7.1: precision 0.87 on the rare a1->S2 component). The recorded predicate uses only observed variables. Dev: P 0.54, R 0.74, F1 0.63, mass recall 0.77. Precision is limited because many rare-a1-rewarded D1s early in the episode or at high value stay below threshold.
